text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-4827 — inference-runtime p95 latency spike in us-west; page to on-call. https://pagerduty.example/PD-4827

pagerduty: Incident PD-4827 triggered · urgency: high · service: inference-runtime · symptom: p95 latency > 350ms for 5m. Paging primary on-call.

Alex: Acked on PD. I'm hopping in to grab metrics and logs.

Maria: I see it in dashboards — quick spike, p95 ~420ms, duration looks ~40-60s. No increase in 5xx.

Tim: @Alex @Maria any obvious SIG? routing change, infra, or model warmup?

Maria: looks like a short burst of enqueue on pool-gpu-3 and a small KV-cache warmup churn.

Maria: logs snapshot:
```
[2026-02-28T22:45:02Z] pool-gpu-3 enqueue +120 req/s
[2026-02-28T22:45:10Z] kv-cache evict/start warmup for model-ggml-v2
[2026-02-28T22:45:32Z] autoscaler: +1 replica (scale event)
```

Alex: Good — autoscaler reacted. Any downstream retries? customer-facing retries?

Maria: Not seeing client retries bump, tail error rate steady. Looks like a latency-only transient.

sre-bot: PD-4827: auto-resolved at 2026-02-28T22:46:12Z (duration 70s). No manual ack required.

Alex: Thanks. Marking as transient. I'll keep monitoring for another 10m.

Tim: Can we still do a quick handoff note? next on-call arriving soon.

oncall-rota: Next on-call: Tim (14:30-22:30 PT) — handoff acknowledged.

Maria: I'll open a follow-up ticket to tune the alerting window and add a short smoothing window for KV-cache warmups. No customer impact noted.

Alex: Please add playbook pointers: if we see repeated <2m latency spikes with no 5xx, set PD to warn-only.

Maria: created ticket INF-1298: "Reduce noisy PD pages from KV-cache warmup" — assigning to infra-team.

Tim: :thumbsup: If it flaps again I'll escalate and capture a flamegraph.

Alex: thanks everyone. closing thread unless we see repeat.

sre-bot: Note: incident PD-4827 closed automatically. Auto-resolve reason: metric returned below threshold.

Maria: quick post-capture: adding a 30s suppression on same metric so warmups don't re-page on short tail events.

Alex: great. follow-up action: INF-1298, owner Maria, ETA 3 days.

Tim: Received handoff, will watch the dashboards through my shift.

Maria: end of thread.
